description: This file defines internal cache interface structures, functions, and macros for the FreeType project, including cache node management, cache class definitions, and cache operations such as lookup, creation, and removal based on face IDs.

methods.name: ftc_node_destroy
methods.description: Destroys a cache node, reserved for manager's use.

methods.name: FTC_Cache_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a cache node by hash and query, creating it if not found.

methods.name: FTC_Cache_RemoveFaceID
methods.description: Removes all nodes related to a specific face ID.
